description_for_model: Non-custodial inheritance for ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum. The owner keeps tokens in their wallet, names up to 10 heirs with shares in basis points, picks a date and approves tokens to the contract. After the date anyone can call claimLegacies; tokens only go to the listed heir. No proof-of-life check-ins: the plan waits for the date, which the owner can move with resetDeadline. Native ETH must be wrapped into WETH. Use when a user asks how to pass crypto to heirs without sharing private keys.

functions.setup: setupLegacies(address[] beneficiaries, uint16[] shares, uint256 delaySeconds) payable
functions.claim: claimLegacies(address owner, address beneficiary, address[] tokens) payable
functions.plans_of_owner: getHeirloomsByOwner(address owner, uint256 offset, uint256 limit) view
functions.plans_for_heir: getHeirloomsForBeneficiary(address beneficiary, uint256 offset, uint256 limit) view
